_note: Roman image guidelines (2026-10-20, replaces the LoRA prompt pools; the old LoRA prompt pools are in the archive). Every image of Roman is made by Codex with the Higgsfield plugin, model Soul 2.0, from the saved Higgsfield character (content/roman_prompt.py builds the prompt from the parts below; workflows/roman_check.py checks the result; the app adds the German text and the CTA, no logo or website). {side} = the edge Roman stands at (right for S-R, left for S-L), {other} = the opposite side. A combination is <side>/<background>/<pose>/<hologram>, e.g. S-L/BG-2/P-3/H-1: 2 x 3 x 3 x 3 = 54.

higgsfield._note: UNKNOWN until checked in Codex: the exact way the plugin references a saved character (this token, a character id parameter, or both), the Soul 2.0 model id, and the credits per image. aspectRatios is the user's list for Soul 2.0 (2026-10-20); every job is validated against it.
higgsfield.estimateNote: estimate, not calibrated: 5 credits and $0.075 per credit are the unverified Phase 3 figures; record the real credits with `ca higgsfield record` and update these numbers

canvasAspects._note: target canvas aspect -> the Soul 2.0 aspect generated; a different target is cropped person-safe (workflows/roman_check.py safe_crop); nothing is upscaled beyond the generated size without saying so

fixed.framing: {token}, small in frame, wide medium shot from the waist up, camera pulled far back. He {verb} at the far {side} edge of the image, occupying only the {side}most 20% of the frame width, the {side} frame edge cutting through his far shoulder and arm. The center and {other} of the image contain no person.
fixed.gazeAndPose: {pose}, body angled slightly toward the {other}, face turned toward the camera with head level, eyes looking directly into the lens, {expression}.
fixed.wardrobe: Tailored dark navy suit, crisp white shirt.
fixed.lighting: Soft even frontal key light on his face, subtle blue rim light on his shoulders and hair.
fixed.hologram: Holographic layer: confined to the {side} third of the frame, {hologram}
fixed.negativeSpace: The {other} two-thirds of the frame is quiet negative space: {fade} fading into deep near-black navy shadow, very low contrast, no holograms, {bans}, no light sources, no bright reflections, {tail}so text added later stays readable.
fixed.lightAndColor: Light and color: deep midnight navy and near-black overall, royal blue #004BA0 glow around him, sky blue #69BFF8 only as small highlights on the holograms.
fixed.finish: Photorealistic corporate photography, 35mm lens, f/2.8, eye level, {subject} in sharp focus, {holoWord} crisp, {blur} softly blurred. No text, letters or numbers anywhere, no logos.
